critical_defects_found.title: Cross-Module SQLAlchemy Relationship Initialization Failure
critical_defects_found.description: The application fails to start due to SQLAlchemy mapper configuration errors when handling relationships between models in different modules. The SoggettoAnagrafico model (anagrafica_italiana module) defines relationships to Proprietario, Affittuario, and Tecnico models from other modules. When Python loads the models, it attempts to resolve these relationships, but the related models haven't been imported yet, causing sqlalchemy.exc.InvalidRequestError.
critical_defects_found.root_cause: SQLAlchemy's declarative base uses a shared registry. When a model is first imported and its class is created, SQLAlchemy attempts to configure all declared relationships. If the related class (e.g., Affittuario) hasn't been imported yet, the mapper configuration fails. The current import order in app/main.py doesn't guarantee all models are loaded before any model's relationships are configured.
steps_to_reproduce: Start backend with: python -m uvicorn app.main:app
Error occurs: 'Mapper Mapper[SoggettoAnagrafico] has no property affittuari'
critical_defects_found.expected_behavior: Backend should start without errors. All models should be imported and relationships configured successfully.
critical_defects_found.actual_behavior: Backend fails during initialization with SQLAlchemy mapper configuration error. Application doesn't reach 'Application startup complete' state.
critical_defects_found.impact: Complete platform unavailable - cannot test any functionality
critical_defects_found.error_log: sqlalchemy.exc.InvalidRequestError: One or more mappers failed to initialize - can't proceed with initialization of other mappers. Triggering mapper: 'Mapper[Affittuario(affittuari)]'. Original exception was: Mapper 'Mapper[SoggettoAnagrafico(soggetti_anagrafici)]' has no property 'affittuari'. If this property was indicated from other mappers or configure events, ensure registry.configure() has been called.
suggested_fixes: Use SQLAlchemy event listeners to defer relationship configuration until all models are loaded
Implement a model registry that explicitly imports all models in dependency order before Base.metadata.create_all()
Use fully qualified string references with registry.configure() called explicitly after all imports
Restructure models to use lazy relationship evaluation or defer_init strategy
Create an __init__ in each module that imports all its models upfront before any routes are imported
